select NVl(fri.BENCHMARK_ID_ACCURACY, 1) * nvl(fri.COEFFICIENT, 1)*nvl(miri.INT_RATE,0) + NVl(fri.SPREAD_RATE, 0) from FIN_RATE_INFO fri left join MST_INT_RATE_INFO miri on fri.BENCHMARK_ID = miri.INT_RATE_ID where fri.EFF_DATE <= to_date('yyyy-MM-dd',#{sysDate}) and miri.EFF_DATE <= to_date('yyyy-MM-dd',#{sysDate}) and fri.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and ROWNUM = 1 order by fri.EFF_DATE desc ,miri.EFF_DATE desc

select eebp.BID_PRIN_AMT * 100 - nvl(T1.sumSubAmt, 0) from ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE eebp left join(select sum(T.subAmt) sumSubAmt, T.ENTRUST_ID, T.PORTFOLIO_ID,T.BID_PRICE from (select nvl(bobp.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT, 0) subAmt, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID,bobp.BID_PRICE from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID where bo.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and bo.TRADE_STATUS != '03' union all select nvl(wbobp.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT, 0) subAmt, wbobp.ENTRUST_ID, wbobp.PORTFOLIO_ID,wbobp.BID_PRICE from Wfl_BID_ORDER wbo left join Wfl_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE wbobp on wbo.BID_ID = wbobp.BID_ID) T group by T.ENTRUST_ID, T.PORTFOLIO_ID,T.BID_PRICE) T1 on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = eebp.PORTFOLIO_ID and T1.ENTRUST_ID = eebp.ENTRUST_ID and T1.BID_PRICE = eebp.BID_PRICE where eebp.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and eebp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{protfolioId} and eebp.BID_PRICE = #{bidPrice}

select count(*) num from TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO tbmsi left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tbmsi.TRADE_ID = tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join BID_ORDER bo on bo.BID_ID = tfpdt.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId} and tbmsi.SETTLE_STATUS = '02' and tfpdt.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
